set.body: Owner ScalaFIM fit shared. Consumer PLS Neuro real whole-brain admission found PreparedFitContexts.prepare unconditionally calls seriesEither(chunkPlan.selection), materializing all voxels before chunks. RunwiseLeastSquares and FixedEffects prepare only run partitions from selected timepoints; LSS prepares design from timepoints. Reproduce through public FitPlanExecutor.fitChunked with a reader rejecting requests over the declared chunk width. Add precise preparation capability to use axes alone where sufficient; preserve response-dependent preparation for OLS with pooled weighting/GLS/robust/latent models, not silently estimating from a subset. Acceptance: regression fails old code for oversized read; synchronous and bounded-future runwise, fixed-effects and LSS preserve exact selection/order/results with no over-width preparation read; existing fit tests JVM and JS. This concerns input read bounds for eligible estimators, not constant total memory or all-estimator streaming. Track consumer linkage to plsneuro bd-01M1SAV0AF4P4X8BQRRE8MJBA0.
set.title: Prepare runwise fixed-effects and LSS chunks without full response reads
